summary: Shows how to change the download location with `-p`/`--download-path` and how to install the downloaded collections on an offline host. Run `ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml` from inside the downloaded folder.
questions: How do I change the folder that ansible-galaxy collection download saves to?
Once I've downloaded collections, how do I install them on the offline machine?
What's in the folder after running collection download?
Can I install several collections from a namespace directory at once?

answer_card.title: Install downloaded collections on an offline host
answer_card.answer_md:
Choose the output folder with `-p` / `--download-path`:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection download my_namespace.my_collection -p ~/offline-collections
```

The folder will contain the requested collections, their dependencies, and a `requirements.yml`. Copy it to the host without Galaxy access and install from inside it:

```bash
cd ~/offline-collections
ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml
```

You can also install every collection under a namespace directory with `ansible-galaxy collection install /path/to/ns`.
